## Quality Gate Verification
Ensure all applicable checks pass prior to requesting review:
- [ ] `make lint` passes cleanly (Ruff + ESLint)

- [ ] `make typecheck` passes without errors (Mypy + TypeScript)

- [ ] No secrets or sensitive configuration committed
